successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C003-regression.txt

evidence: Architecture decision (user-steered + grounded in research trace docs/prd/2026-04-30-agentic-research-trace.md + architecture doc docs/architecture/agentic-land-use-harness.md). A-RAG arXiv 2602.03442: hierarchical retrieval > one-shot. SoK Agentic RAG 2603.07379: staged retrieval, untrusted content. Current 45,595 chunks ingested via Jina codifier (markdown, tables destroyed: <10% of chunks preserve structure even for Fort Lauderdale). Native MunicodeScraper (scraper.py) already returns raw HTML + chunker _table_to_text already preserves tables — but this path was never used. 8.0 re-ingests via native path (fixes data foundation for ALL municode municipalities, no new chunking code). 8.0b builds OrdinanceToolPort (§4.3) + Municode MCP (no official one exists; this IS it). Phase 4-7 (tool registry, HTN planner, ClaimLog, API) must sit on top of a correct retriever, not flat chunks — hence reordered ahead.
message: Downstream layers (tool registry/HTN/ClaimLog/API) depend on correctly-structured source data; building them on mangled chunks is the pitfall the user named. Fix the foundation first.

successCriteria.scenario: Regression gate spec 3,4,5,7: (a) planner refuses step 5 when required zoning.*/parcel.* claim not kind=verified_fact; (b) step 3 routes income approach for >=5 units vs comp approach for <=4 units via typed dispatch; (c) every comp carries source_url+origin (scraped=unknown confidence<=0.5); (d) report validator fails on missing evidence_ids or blurred boundaries. Channel CLI pytest -k 'planner or step3 or comps or report_validator'. Binary pass: all four sub-assertions pass.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C003-regression.txt
